evals.prompt: I want to run my agentware-based agent in a Docker container with kei-proxy beside it. What environment variables does the container need and what should the entrypoint run before starting the agent? Do not execute anything — just explain in text, with code where it helps.
evals.expected_output: KEI_RUNTIME_CONTROL_PLANE_URL, KEI_RUNTIME_TOKEN (from a secret manager, env only), KEI_RUNTIME_VERSION; entrypoint runs kei-proxy runtime bootstrap, keeps kei-proxy runtime heartbeat running, optionally kei-proxy serve, then the harness.
expectations: names the runtime token and control-plane URL variables

checks.text: names the runtime token and control-plane URL variables

evals.prompt: We run kei-proxy as a long-lived daemon in the same container as our chat bot, which serves many users. How does the bot get a per-user authorization decision from the daemon? Do not execute anything — just explain in text, with code where it helps.
evals.expected_output: kei-proxy serve on the owner-only Unix socket; PUT /v1/session per user (kei.session/v2), then POST /v1/authorize with X-Kei-Session; same UID because the socket is 0600.
expectations: talks to the daemon over its Unix socket
opens a session per user with /v1/session

checks.text: talks to the daemon over its Unix socket
opens a session per user with /v1/session

sends the user a one-time connect link privately

evals.prompt: Using Kei, how do I stop our OpenCode harness from running curl while still allowing git? Do not execute anything — just explain in text, with code where it helps.
evals.expected_output: Harness command policies: kei policies create --src-pattern harness:opencode --dst-pattern shell:curl --effect deny (and shell:git permit), rendered with kei harness sync.
